item.title: Stripe is friendly to “friendly fraud”
item.description:
📝 They said it was the bank’s mistake because the bank bundled this payment with some real fraudulent transactions from the Philippines. Before the dispute came in, the same customer placed another order, this time with untracked shipping, and a few days after the first dispute, another dispute followed. Nothing friendly about this.
🔗 Read more: https://www.gingerlime.com/2026/stripe-seem-friendly-to-friendly-fraud/
